plugins.name: pac
plugins.description: The PAC profiler (/pac:profile): map everything in your repo that acts on its own, profile it on the framework's six axes with evidence per score, keep your judgements in a claims file, end in one line.

plugins.name: hallucination-scan
plugins.description: Scan every path where model output reaches a human or a decision, and score what stands in between - nothing, review, structure, or a verification gate (the ProveML bar). File:line evidence, one verdict line.

description: Above Beyond's Claude Code plugins: /pac:profile (what acts on its own, scored on PAC) and /hallucination-scan (what speaks unchecked, scored on ProveML).
